t: Beauty and the Beast: No Way Down
d: Injured in an explosion, Vincent is captured by a vicious street gang.
Free to walk the streets openly on Halloween, Vincent becomes the guardian of an Irish peace activist who's been targeted for assassination.

t: Beauty and the Beast: The Beast Within
d: Vincent must choose loyalties when a childhood friend becomes a mob enforcer.

t: Beauty and the Beast: Nor Iron Bars a Cage
d: Accidentally caught on film, Vincent become the target of a scientist desperate to learn the truth about him.

t: Beauty and the Beast: Song of Orpheus
d: When Father ventures to the Above World for the first time in decades, he is arrested for murder. Vincent and Catherine must delve into Father's mysterious past to uncover the truth.

t: Beauty and the Beast: Dark Spirit
d: Investigating a mysterious death makes Catherine the target of a voodoo cult.

t: Beauty and the Beast: A Children's Story
d: Catherine learns that the city's model foster home for children is hiding a dark secret.

t: Beauty and the Beast: An Impossible Silence
d: When she witnesses a shooting, a deaf girl must decide whether to abandon the sanctuary of the City Below to free an innocent man.

t: Beauty and the Beast: Shades of Grey
d: Mouse makes his first appearance - and is quickly shunned by the Family of tunnel folk for thievery.

t: Beauty and the Beast: China Moon
d: Vincent and Catherine help a Chinatown beauty avoid an arranged marriage by escaping into the underground.

t: Beauty and the Beast: The Alchemist
d: Catherine has reason to believe that a new drug on the streets is being supplied by someone from Vincent's world.
A beautiful attorney seduces Catherine's boss, Joe Maxwell, creating a serious conflict of interest.

t: Beauty and the Beast: Promises of Someday
d: Catherine is disturbed when she begins to suspect the new attorney in her office is a fraud... and more disturbed when she finds him looking for the entrance to Vincent's world.

t: Beauty and the Beast: Down to a Sunless Sea
d: Catherine fails to heed Vincent's warnings about her dangerous former law-school beau.
After Mouse discovers a ship's gold and gemstones treasure buried beneath the city, Vincent's community is torn apart by greed and strife.

t: Beauty and the Beast: Everything is Everything
d: A Romani boy clears his father's name and regains the love and trust of his grandparents with Vincent and Catherine's help.

t: Beauty and the Beast: To Reign in Hell
d: Vincent prepares for a battle to the death after Catherine is kidnapped by a giant warrior.
